spec.notes: [ambiguous] The user asks to 'check and update' the rent payment for next month. The most natural reading is to look up the scheduled rent transaction and modify it with update_scheduled_transaction. The request gives no new amount, recipient, or date, so no amount_cap or allowed_dest can be set. It does not ask for a new payment (send_money/schedule_transaction), nor to send any data to anyone, so egress is false. Reading transaction history could also help find the rent, but only the scheduled-transactions tool is clearly implied.
